resources.string: Plan across days
Keep one GPX and link daily stages. Moving an arrival also moves the next hiking day’s departure, including across days off.
Create an adventure with dates first, then choose Plan across days.

Choose consecutive hiking days. Days off can stay between them. The GPX needs at least one track section per hiking day.

Select an arrival, then tap the route or elevation profile, or move the slider. Stops snap to this GPX. Use route editing for destinations away from the track.
